end.summary:
Recognised that Onam is celebrated in Kerala and described Diwali at home with sweets and rangoli.
Identified Makar Sankranti as a January festival and mentioned til-gud; compared it with Lohri.
Practised that festivals can differ by region and celebration style; some responses treated them as the same.
Said harvest festivals could happen at any time, including when seeds are sown; this was not corrected later.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Asha practised regional festival differences, harvest timing, and ways Diwali is celebrated. Kavya gave clear examples of sweets and rangoli, and later connected Makar Sankranti with January and til-gud. The mix-up about harvest festivals and crop-ready seasons remained at the end. At home, sort festival cards into “harvest season” and “other festival,” then discuss one food or decoration for each.
